---
title: Report
---

```{avenger-sql}
CREATE TEMP TABLE weights AS (
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('Europe' AS origin, 3 AS cars), STRUCT('Japan', 5), STRUCT('USA', 8)])
)
```

```{avenger-sql}
#| label: fig-cars
#| fig-cap: Cars by origin
FROM weights |> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => origin, y => cars) AS chart
```

The cars by origin are in @fig-cars.

```{avenger-sql}
#| echo: false
#| error: true
FROM weights |> SELECT nope
```
